text:
leo: kicking off rollout for zephyr-7b-v2. Change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Canary -> eu-west only. Pin enterprise customers to zephyr-7b-v1 for 24h.

nina: noted. Can we confirm fallback ordering? we should prefer the quantized v1 before falling back to titan-lite.

leo: fallback order: zephyr-7b-v2 -> zephyr-7b-v1-quant -> zephyr-7b-v1 -> titan-lite. rationale: maintain latency benefits but preserve quality fallback.

maria: add note to ops: lock pin for customers in the "enterprise" tag group. Also include opt-out label for platform teams that want early access.

deploybot: preflight checks started for zephyr-7b-v2 (canary eu-west).
- model artifact checksum: ok
- infra health: ok
- slot capacity: ok
- telemetry hooks: configured

sre-oncall: watching infra. If host GPU mem anomaly > 10% or p99 latency spikes > 300ms across canary nodes, call rollback.

dan: QA will run the sanity promptset and regen checks at +10m and +30m after canary. qa-bot will post results.

deploybot: canary deploy started at 1779999000.

qa-bot: sanity run completed (+10m): 120/120 prompts passed. regens: 3 non-actionable diffs (style). quality delta vs v1: -0.4% weighted; within tolerance.

leo: nice. telemetry gating rules:
- rollback if p50 latency increase > 200ms sustained for 5m
- rollback if error rate > 0.5% for 3m
- rollback if hallucination rate (eval set) increases > 3% absolute

maria: documented rollback signals in the runbook. snippet for ops:
```
if metrics.window(5m).p50_delta > 200ms or metrics.errors.rate > 0.005:
  deploybot rollback --reason "latency/error spike"
```

nina: release notes draft (short): "Enabled zephyr-7b-v2 in catalog (canary eu-west). Improved throughput and lower memory footprint; fallback ordering updated. Enterprise tenants pinned to previous v1 for 24h."

leo: rolling to 10% traffic in eu-west if canary stays green for 30m. who owns the post-cutover telemetry dashboard?

maria: I'll own the dashboard and set alerts. tagging: @sre-oncall for escalation, @dan for QA anomalies.

sre-oncall: I'll be on pager. set alert thresholds to p50/p95 and error rate. linking runbook.

deploybot: canary healthy at +30m. metrics: p50 +12ms, error rate 0.02%, token cost -6%. advancing to 10% traffic.

dan: QA regen at +40m shows 1 new diff flagged for investigation. not a blocker; will monitor.

leo: proceeding to broadening plan in 2h if no signal. final check: is pin window length okay? 24h for enterprise + automated unpin after.

maria: yes. auto-unpin job scheduled. ops note: save canary logs for 72h.

nina: tagging release-notes: add note about fallback order and rollback criteria.

leo: 👍 :shipit:

deploybot: rollout progressed to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over change window. final status: complete. If any post-cutover issues, create thread in #incidents and mention @sre-oncall.

qa-bot: post-rollout sanity: all standard promptsets passed. no action items.

leo: closing thread. thanks everyone.
